items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: He played with Tick Johnson out of Baton Rouge. ... He played with Tick Johnson.

ctx.x: Well of course we can ask him some more. I didn't get to hear the interview. I wasn't there. But I hope we have most of the information on his life. But I'm wondering also about your other uncle John that played trumpet.
Well Johnny played. He played a long ride. He played with Tick Johnson out of Baton Rouge.
By the way do you know his address or have it at Tick?
